overview_description.description:
Brumbrum is a provider of used vehicles for sale with up to 3 years of warranty that can be purchased online. The company's goal is to revolutionize the car market by offering a simple, innovative, practical, and competitive shopping experience.

Brumbrum was founded in 2016 and is based in Milan, Italy.

about_short_description.short_description: Brumbrum is a provider of used vehicles for sale with up to 3 years of warranty that can be purchased online.

product.name: Used Vehicles for Sale
product.description: Online platform offering a wide range of used cars from various brands, available for purchase with verified mileage and detailed inspection reports.

product.name: Vehicle Reconditioning and Inspection (Factory brumbrum)
product.description: A facility in Reggio Emilia where used cars undergo thorough inspection, mechanical repairs, bodywork, and cleaning before sale.

product.name: Vehicle Delivery and Pickup Services
product.description: Options for customers to receive purchased vehicles via home delivery across Italy or to pick them up at the Factory or partner centers.

product.name: Vehicle Financing Services
product.description: Online financing options allowing customers to purchase used cars with payment plans, including customizable rates.

product.name: Warranty and Roadside Assistance
product.description: A 12-month warranty on used vehicles covering defects and breakdowns, with optional extension up to 3 years, including roadside assistance in Italy and Europe.

product.name: Vehicle Return Policy
product.description: Allows customers to return purchased vehicles within 14 days or 1,000 km for a full refund if conditions are met.
